blocking_objections.OBJ-1: P-MISS is neither disjoint nor exhaustive; the most likely miss outcome satisfies neither branch. Discharge: define MISS-MARGINAL := P-MISS AND NOT MISS-STRUCTURED.
blocking_objections.OBJ-2: The contract uses two different counterfactuals. Section 4 defines mu_rep = P_pred - T; section 6 computes CR-1 and CR-2 from the committed residual. Self-consistent counts under section 4 are 20/5/18 with 28 powerless, not 21/4/18 with 27. Discharge: pick one counterfactual, restate every count and every named tuple set under it.
blocking_objections.OBJ-3: Determinism is not achieved: no seed derivable for the KNOWNANSWER arm, KA-1 and KA-4 collide on their key, the without-replacement pre-mark names a distribution rather than an algorithm, numpy unpinned. Discharge: name the algorithm and the stream consumption order, key the KNOWNANSWER seeds, pin numpy.
blocking_objections.OBJ-4: MISS-MARGINAL's [3,10) band is an escape hatch on the severity axis. Discharge: cut the band at 4.000.

correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.carried_forward_not_edited: The TASK-20260729-015 receipt is immutable and stands as written. This entry supersedes one of its claims.
correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.what_that_receipt_said: That all eleven load-bearing contract figures were recomputed from the committed BATCH-011 results and REPRODUCED EXACTLY, and that nothing was corrected.
correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.why_that_is_incomplete: True of what was computed, but the computation used SECTION 6's counterfactual - the committed residual - and therefore verified the contract's arithmetic under one of its two readings without detecting that the contract mixes two. A verification that confirms internal consistency with the wrong section is not a verification of the contract.
correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.independent_reconfirmation_of_the_review: Re-running the same check under SECTION 4's definition (mu_rep = P_pred - T) reproduces the reviewer's counts EXACTLY: CR-1 20/48, CR-2 5/48, CR-3 18/48, 28 powerless tuples.
correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.sharpest_case_confirmed: At T-18-2-B264 the missing pre-marking term T is 0.8753 bins against a committed residual of -27.997 bins - 32 times too small to explain it. Across ALL m=2 tuples T never exceeds 0.9978 bins. Section 6 nonetheless lists that tuple among those where CR-1 can fire under the full counterfactual.
correction_to_the_TASK_20260729_015_rece.not_a_new_physical_finding: This is a bookkeeping inconsistency in the contract, not a new anomaly. That the pre-marking term explains nothing at m=2 is exactly what both BATCH-011 reviewers already recorded: the fault is invisible at m=2 and dominant at m=3.
